descriptions.nlp: NLP, corpora, machine translation, chatbots, and OCR terms. The field is computational linguistics and natural language processing: corpora, machine translation, language models, chatbots, information retrieval, optical character recognition, text summarization, named-entity recognition, finite automata.
descriptions.medicine: Disease, drug, pathogen, anatomy, procedure, and diagnostic terms. Biomedical and medical terminology covers diseases, pharmaceuticals, ATC drug codes, infectious pathogens, viruses, bacteria, anatomy, surgical procedures, diagnostic tests, and immunology.
descriptions.education: Universities, schools, colleges, academic disciplines, and education terms. Education and academic institutions: universities, schools, colleges, vocational institutes, international education, higher education, educational sciences, language learning, academic disciplines.
descriptions.finance: Finance, banking, accounting, marketing, retail, and economics terms. The field is finance, banking, accounting, and commerce: financial services, central banks, currencies, accounting, payment cards and digital wallets, investment funds, securities exchanges, insurance, marketing, and supply chains.
descriptions.legal: Government, law, politics, economics, and international relations terms. The field is politics, law, and political economy, covering governments, parliaments, courts, elections, treaties, international organizations, wars, human rights, finance, and corporations.
descriptions.environment: Ecology, biodiversity, geography, pollution, climate, and conservation terms. Environmental studies covers environmental law, environmental chemistry, climate change, ozone depletion, invasive species, plastic pollution, municipal solid waste, water supply and sanitation, energy conservation, biogeography.
descriptions.entertainment: Film, television, music, video game, and pop culture terms. Entertainment and media covers films, television series, video games, music genres, songs and albums, musicians, actors, awards, broadcasters, and anime.
descriptions.science: Taxonomy, ecology, humanities, social science, and engineering terms. Academic disciplines and biological taxonomy covers species and families, ecology, botany, zoology, linguistics, anthropology, political science, economics, engineering, and medicine.
descriptions.sports: Athletes, teams, leagues, tournaments, venues, and rules terms. This field is sports: association football, baseball, basketball, tennis, Olympic Games, leagues, tournaments, teams, athletes, venues.
descriptions.art: Art, architecture, media, literature, music, and heritage terms. Arts and culture covers painting, sculpture, architecture, museums, historic sites, film, television, literature, music, and design.
